mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate indicates a robust economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong GDP growth, or the correlation between GDP growth and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances with high federal funds rates, or the federal funds rate does not Granger-cause S&P 500 returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate below 4% indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with low unemployment, or the correlation between unemployment and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates a strong supply chain, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong industrial production growth, or the correlation between industrial production and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between GDP growth and consumer spending indicates a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong GDP growth and consumer spending, or the interaction term between GDP growth and consumer spending is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between the federal funds rate and inflation indicates a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances with high federal funds rates and inflation, or the interaction term between the federal funds rate and inflation is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A high employment rate above 130,000 indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with high employment, or the correlation between employment and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between housing starts and GDP growth indicates a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong housing starts and GDP growth, or the interaction term between housing starts and GDP growth is not significant (p > 0.1).
